title: NX-100 示例手册
content_zh: NX-100 使用 12 V DC、1 A 电源适配器。不支持 PoE 供电。通电后 PWR 指示灯应为绿色常亮。
content_en: NX-100 requires a 12 V DC, 1 A adapter. PoE is not supported. The PWR LED should be solid green after power-on.

title: NX-100 示例手册
content_zh: NX-100 的 NET 红灯表示未获得有效网络连接。先检查网线与交换机端口，再确认上游网络启用了 DHCP。设备仅支持 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi，不支持 5 GHz。手册未提供静态 IP 配置步骤。
content_en: A red NET LED on NX-100 indicates no valid network connection. Check the Ethernet cable and switch port, then confirm DHCP is enabled upstream. Wi-Fi supports 2.4 GHz only, not 5 GHz. This manual does not include static IP setup instructions.

title: NX-100 示例手册
content_zh: NX-100 通电时长按 RESET 10 秒可恢复出厂设置。此操作会清除已保存的网络配置；执行前请记录配置。普通断电重启不等于恢复出厂设置。
content_en: Hold RESET for 10 seconds while NX-100 is powered on to restore factory settings. This erases saved network settings; record them first. A normal power cycle is not a factory reset.

title: NX-200 示例手册
content_zh: NX-200 使用 24 V DC、0.5 A 电源。不支持 PoE 供电。不要将 NX-100 的电源配置用于本型号。
content_en: NX-200 requires 24 V DC, 0.5 A power. PoE is not supported. Do not use the NX-100 power specification for this model.

title: NX-200 示例手册
content_zh: NX-200 仅支持有线以太网，不支持 Wi-Fi。LINK 灯不亮时检查网线和交换机端口；LINK 灯亮但设备离线时，请收集设备时间、端口状态及上游 DHCP 分配结果，交由人工支持排查。
content_en: NX-200 supports wired Ethernet only, not Wi-Fi. If LINK is off, check the cable and switch port. If LINK is on but the device is offline, collect the device time, port status and upstream DHCP assignment for human support.

title: NX-200 示例手册
content_zh: NX-200 通电时长按 RESET 15 秒可恢复出厂设置，并清除网络配置和本地规则。执行前请备份配置与规则。
content_en: Hold RESET for 15 seconds while NX-200 is powered on to restore factory settings. Network settings and local rules are erased. Back up configurations and rules before proceeding.
